headline: Houthis Tighten Grip on Red Sea Gateway as Iran Threatens Global Oil Routes
facebook_description: Yemen's government forces are withdrawing from positions near Bab el-Mandeb, giving Iran-aligned Houthis greater leverage over a vital shipping corridor. The strait remains open, but maritime advisories indicate substantial security threats and reduced commercial traffic. Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline offers an alternative to Hormuz, yet tankers headed toward Asia face risks near Yemen. The withdrawal raises concerns about global shipping costs and energy security without establishing that a new oil supply interruption has occurred. Could pressure on both waterways threaten global energy markets? Follow Epic Perspective News for developments. #EPNews #RedSea #Yemen #EnergySecurity
